images.caption:
First lighthouse was established here in 1903. In the late 1980s, Green’s Point became a monitoring station for several other lighthouses in the area. After being fully automated since 1996, Green’s Point Light was officially decommissioned on September 8, 1999, though the fog alarm remains in use.
The lighthouse is owned by Green's Point Light Association.
